In partial modification of the Notice mentioned in
the Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 22.07.2026;
(1) Hon’ble the Chief Justice Mrs. Justice Sunita Agarwal and
Hon’ble Ms. Justice Nisha M. Thakore would sit in
Division Bench and take up the matters notified in the
Cause List of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble the Chief
